criterion: A Data Management Plan (or explicit DMP section in documentation) is accessible
Provenance, access conditions, and licenses of third-party data inputs are documented
Data are in open non-proprietary file formats
A README or data dictionary defines all variables, units, and data structures
The dataset carries an explicit open license
Data are archived in a persistent repository with a citable DOI
Third-party libraries, dependencies, and code versions are explicitly declared
Code is under version control with public commit history
The repository contains an OSI-approved open-source license file
Instructions and execution environments are documented so outputs can be reproduced
A release tag or snapshot is archived with a persistent identifier
Contributor roles and authorship division are specified
Prior open artifacts, literature, and dependencies are cited with identifiers
The paper or preprint is accessible in an open repository under an open license
The methodology is described in enough detail to replicate the derivation
